description: Create a new collection (folder) in the user's Grabblist to organize saved items.

budget.description: Total spending target for this collection (e.g. 1500 for "Build PC under $1500")

color.description: Hex color for the collection (e.g. "#3B82F6", "#22C55E", "#A855F7", "#EC4899", "#F59E0B", "#EF4444"). Default: #3B82F6

description.description: Short description of what this collection is for

icon.description: Material Symbols icon name (e.g. "devices", "home", "shopping_bag", "checkroom", "directions_car", "favorite"). Default: inventory_2

name.description: Collection name, e.g. "Gaming Setup" or "Gift Ideas"

reason.description: Why this change was made (shown to user in change history)

name: create_collection
